title: Channels
compose_note: Sending a message yourself pauses the assistant on this thread until you hand it back.
empty_body: Only the phone line is connected, so everything arrives as a call. Install WhatsApp or web chat and customers can write instead — appointment changes are quicker to type than to say.
offline_title: WhatsApp session logged out — messages are queuing
offline_body_before: The phone that hosts the WhatsApp session signed out at
offline_body_after: . 6 messages have arrived since and nobody has answered them.
error_body: Another process is holding the database file — usually a backup that did not finish cleanly. Messages arriving now are kept in the queue and will appear once the lock clears. No conversation is lost.
